ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the upper part of the figure is labeled VDD = 2 V, and below it is connected to a downward 5 μA current source; the node at the lower end of the current source is led out to the right as Vout. This node is simultaneously connected to the drain of the NMOS, and is connected to the gate of the NMOS through the left-side wire, so the NMOS is in diode-connected form. The NMOS source is grounded, and the figure gives W/L = 10 μm / 1 μm = 10. Then reason: since the source is grounded and the gate and drain are shorted, VGS = Vout, and the current source makes the NMOS drain current ID = 5 μA. The diode-connected NMOS satisfies the saturation condition when conducting, and the square law can be used: ID = (1/2) μn Cox (W/L) (VGS - VT)^2. Substituting μn Cox = 100 μA/V^2 and W/L = 10 gives the coefficient (1/2)×100×10 = 500 μA/V^2. Therefore 5 μA = 500 μA/V^2 × (Vout - 0.5 V)^2, so (Vout - 0.5)^2 = 0.01. Taking the physical conduction solution Vout - 0.5 = 0.1 V gives Vout = 0.6 V. This value is less than the 2 V power-supply voltage, satisfying the circuit conditions.

From the text and geometry, β = μnCox(W/L) = 100 µA/V^2 × 10 = 1000 µA/V^2. Invert the diode-connected MOS characteristic: Vout = VT + sqrt(2ID/β) = 0.5 V + sqrt(2·5 µA / 1000 µA/V^2) = 0.5 V + 0.1 V = 0.6 V. 推理：电流源固定流入输出节点的电流为 5 μA，因此二极管连接 NMOS 必须向地导通 5 μA。平方律且忽略沟道长度调制时，饱和区电流为 ID = (1/2)β(VGS - VT)^2，其中 β = μnCox(W/L)。由题给 μnCox = 100 μA/V^2，图中 W/L = 10，所以 β = 1000 μA/V^2。二极管连接 NMOS 有 VGS = Vout，因此 5 μA = (1/2)(1000 μA/V^2)(Vout - 0.5 V)^2。解得 Vout - 0.5 V = sqrt(2·5/1000) V = 0.1 V，所以 Vout = 0.6 V。该电压小于 2 V，且 VGS > VT，NMOS 导通并满足二极管连接饱和条件。
